text_block_list.text:
The Sumire Stakes. Since it's an 
Open-class race, the competition is 
slightly lower-tier compared to graded 
races.

As long as I can bring out my full 
ability, it seems like I could break 
through, but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing, really~ Seems like I'm 
just a little tired from yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It happens from time to time lately. But 
really, it's nothing to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, Trainer, before the 
race... would you like to have our lunch 
in the central plaza?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I... made all sorts of things, you know. 
Sweet tamagoyaki... and octopus wieners...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yeees, pardon me. I'll just step aside for 
a moment...

After taking a short nap, Super Creek's 
condition improved a little.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Thanks to you, 
somehow...
choice_data_list: Should we scratch from the race?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No, anything but that~! I'm fine. I can 
really, truly run.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It is a pity that I could not see the 
violets together with you, Trainer, but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'll make a little flower bloom in the 
race. I'll do my absolute best.
